title: saxifraga latina
intro: Saxifraga latina, commonly known as Lady's Mantle, is a perennial herb native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa, characterized by its scalloped leaves and clusters of small white or pink flowers. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating menstrual disorders, digestive issues, and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Saxifraga latina include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and astringent properties, making it useful for soothing menstrual cramps and uterine bleeding. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
